items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Then I heard him with Willie Bryant, you know?

ctx.x: Bennie Carter was in that band. Ben Webster was in that band. Teddy Wilson was in that band Willie Bryant had at one time, you know. And Willie Bryant was an entertainer. He wasn't a musician but he liked musicians.
That's right, he was a dancer. He used to dance. He had a dance act at first.
